joint.type: full-height arm beam reaches the screw stations; screws pass through the beam and floor into underside nut recesses
joint.fastener: two vertical M3 screws per arm, passing through the floor into exterior underside nut recesses
joint.fastener_axis_design_coordinates: Y (vertical); screws pass downward through the full-height arm beam and floor into exterior underside nuts
joint.nut_retention: hexagonal pockets open on the exterior underside; nut solids sit inside the pocket depth, with real metal nuts required for assembly
joint.note: The CAD includes simplified screw and nut envelopes for assembly visualization. Nut solids are positioned within the underside-open hex pockets and the screw clearance bores pass through the floor. Use real M3 screws and metal nuts; print-fit, tool access, and flight-load testing are still required.
